keeper_logbook.title: The Keeper’s Logbook
pages: 3 April. Wind southwest. Lamp trimmed 18:40. Lens clear. Mean high water 4 cm above the printed table.
17 May. New line cut on the third stair. The old line is below water at neap tide.
2 June. Table model begun at one to two hundred and forty. Basin, channel, bridge, tower. All levels taken from the island.
19 June. A valve fitted beneath the basin. The model loses water when the bay does. Discharge not visible from the study.
deep:
BOARD QUERY: Where is displaced water received?

REPLY: [the ruled space is blank; the paper is worn through where a word was erased.]

signal_shelf.title: The instrument index
pages: Eight narrow harbour manuals. Each spine binds one stamped figure to an instrument: sun crank, tide staff, basin wheel, music teeth, stone arc, lamp eye, survey rule, or plumb line.
The stamps match the forms cut into the cliff. No values are printed; the bindings point back into the working room and the island beyond it.

coat_letter.title: A letter, folded small
pages: The east room is dry. The blue blanket is in the chest. The kettle draws from the rain tank, not the sea.

No account is required at the door. Come in wet if you must.

— K.
deep: Inside the fold: EAST ROOM — repaired latch; dry boards; spare key beneath the blue cup.

stone_inscription.title: Cut into the standing stone
pages:
WE WHO WENT DOWN
LEFT THE LIGHT FOR
WHOEVER WASHES UP
deep:
Below the old cut, bared by the higher tide:

THE HILL HELD.
THE HALL DID NOT.
BOTH WERE OUR WORK.

bottle_note.title: A note in a bottle, washed up
pages: The bottle was sealed at the jetty at low water. Wind southwest. If it returns to this beach, the west current has reversed.
The lamp room is unlocked. The rain tank is sound. The east room is dry.
deep: On the back: RETURN OBSERVED. Water 11 cm above the mark. Bottle intact.

kelp_slate.title: A wax slate, tangled in the kelp
pages: FIRST WADE. Dark form at twelve paces. Closed distance: form broke apart; water clouded with silt.
SECOND WADE. Held position. Form surfaced once. One low note crossed the bay. Duration: nine breaths.

bluff_cairn.title: A cairn on the bluff, scratched in the top stone
pages: Cairn rebuilt above the wet line. Drowned hall roof visible to the east.
The shore figure was twelve paces nearer after I checked the hall. No wake. No footprints. It did not advance while observed.

source_note.title: A transfer sheet, weighted with a stone
pages: TRANSFER TEST 4. Upper basin lowered: 28 cm. Lower pool raised: 28 cm. Delay: eleven seconds.
Return test incomplete. Wheel seized after reversal. Pressure remained on both sides of the plate.

quarters_journal.title: A journal kept by the cot
pages: Could not sleep through the west gale. Moved the chair against the inner door.
Drew the island again from memory. The channel is too narrow. The east room remains dry in every version.
Lamp trimmed at dusk. Cot lamp left burning until morning.
deep: Later: moved the chair away from the door. Slept with it open. Rain reached the threshold; the east boards stayed dry.

lens_mark_study.title: Lampblack, too small to read by eye
pages: Through the glass: LENS ROTATION 04:10. Beam crossed the west cliff at 04:13. Four figures returned from the cut face.
Order copied in the margin as figures only. No numerals are written here.
deep: A second hand added: CLIFF DRY. HALL FLOODED. Same figures visible on both faces.

lens_mark_stone.title: Scratched into the stone, hair-fine
pages: Through the glass: thirty-seven short strokes, grouped by five. Five longer strokes cross the groups at different angles.
The stone is polished at palm height. The polish overlaps several generations of cuts.
deep: Below the tide line are more strokes, softened but still deliberate. One ends above the water; another continues beneath it.

pool_phial.title: A note sealed in a phial, dried and unrolled
pages: POOL TEST. Phial wedged at dry datum: +14.8 m. It can clear the lip only when the basin reaches the fifth ring.
Paper dried after recovery. Salt line inside the glass: 3 mm below the cork.

drain_ledger.title: A tide ledger, water-swollen
pages: DISTRICT OF LIGHTS — QUARTERLY RETURN. Mean high water: +4 cm against table. Keeper’s staff checked against survey chain: exact.
SECOND QUARTER. Mean high water: +11 cm. Boat-store stair wet at third step during neap. Printed table unchanged.
deep: FINAL RETURN. Archive floor flooded before inspection. Station figures accepted. Printed table withdrawn.

commendation_copy.title: A carbon copy, kept
pages: CARBON RETAINED — RECOMMENDATION FOR COMMENDATION. Returns exact. Lens work within tolerance. Light outages: none. Recommendation submitted despite pending station review.
deep: The retained sheet is top carbon. No impression from an original page is visible beneath it. The signature line is blank.

closure_notice.title: A notice of review, folded small
pages: NOTICE OF REVIEW — DISTRICT OF LIGHTS. Station cost exceeds traffic served. Proposed action: extinguish light; recover instruments and great lens; offer mainland transfer.
deep: The effective date and authorising signature are blank. In the margin: RECEIPT NOT ACKNOWLEDGED.

field_slip.title: A field slip, pinched under the cairn

place.label: a field slip, pinched under stone

pages: FIELD SLIP — wind SW, moderate. Glass falling. North bluff ascent: 22 minutes. Cairn at crest not shown on survey.
deep: Reverse: tower 21.4 m; stair 83 treads; mean high water +11 cm; oil 146 L. Column headed KEEPER RELIEF is blank.

transfer_offer.title: An offer of transfer, never burnt

place.label: a letter, wedged behind the stove

pages: DISTRICT OF LIGHTS — NOTICE OF VACANCY. Mainland station available from spring quarter. Housing included. Two assistants. Application invited.
deep: Draft on reverse, unsent: TRANSFER DECLINED. Reason field first reads STATION REQUIRES KEEPER, then is struck through. No replacement reason.

model_margin.title: The model’s margin, under the glass
pages: Under the glass: SCALE 1:240. ERROR AT WEST CHANNEL: +0.8 mm. ERROR AT UPPER POOL: -0.3 mm.
A smaller model is drawn inside the lamp room. Its basin is marked FULL; the surrounding sea is marked LOW.

music_note.title: A note folded into the music box
pages: Fourth tooth catches again. Filed it. Worse.
Box sequence after filing: E · G · A · D · C. Dawn bird answers from the stone arc.
deep: Inside fold: BIRD, FOURTH NOTE HIGH. 04:52. Clear sky.

text.the_sea_no_longer: The sea no longer answers the wheel down here.
text.the_wheel_turns_and: The wheel turns. The sky follows after a delay.
text.the_hour_will_not: The wheel turns freely. The sky does not move.
text.the_register_has_one: The register begins in one hand. Later entries use different pressure and slant.
text.the_register_counts_the: The register counts {n} distinct hands at this table.
text.the_top_ring_stands: The top ring stands {gap} m clear of the water. Fresh-cut. Nothing has ever reached it.
text.the_water_is_at: The water is at the fifth ring.
text.it_has_to_go_somewhere: The lower gauge rises as the upper basin falls.
text.below_the_window_the: Below the window, the sea obeys.
text.the_crank_resists_as: The crank resists, as if the hours themselves have taken on water.
text.the_little_lamp_drags: The little lamp drags the real sun with it.
text.the_fourth_note_does: The fourth tooth catches. The note falls silent.
text.the_song_comes_up: The song comes up slow and flat, as through water.
text.fallen_and_long_silent: Fallen, and long silent. Knocking on it is like knocking on a door with no room behind it.
text.the_fallen_stone_hums: The fallen stone now carries the low note heard across the kelp.
text.a_cartographer_s_brass: A fifteen-centimetre cartographer’s rule. Brass, straight, unmarked by salt.
text.across_the_island_something: Across the island, something vast settles into place.
text.you_do_not_need: The etched marks align with the model’s survey grid.
text.far_above_glass_settles: Far above, glass settles into brass.
text.on_the_model_s: On the model beach, a rice-grain bottle is corked around a curl of paper.
text.even_here_a_staff: A staff the height of an eyelash stands in the model sea. It has five rings; the top is pale.
text.cold_as_seawater_clear: Cold as seawater, clear as morning — a lamp’s eye, far too fine for a pocket.
text.the_sand_slides_from: The sand slides from a brass door, dialled shut.
text.stone_breath_long_held: The brass door drops inward. Cold air lifts from a lit stair below.
text.heavier_than_it_looks: The brass weight pulls the cord vertical.
text.it_hangs_dead_centre: The plumb hangs over the model beach. The floor plate lies on the same vertical line.
text.stand_on_it: The plate vibrates beneath the plumb line.
text.the_stair_is_roped: The stair is roped off and dark. The lamp socket beside it is empty.
text.a_line_cut_low: Cut low into the wet stone: “RETURN FLOW +11 SEC.”
text.locked_not_from_this: The latch turns. The hinges do not move.
text.glass_and_brass_wedged: Glass and brass are wedged below the dry pool lip, beyond a hand’s reach.
text.the_bottom_of_the: The bottom of the world, and the pool is finally full. The phial rides the risen water, and your hand closes around it.
text.a_keeper_s_reading: A keeper’s reading glass. Through it, the faint marks resolve — there is writing everywhere you did not see.
text.that_is_all_of: Nine lampblack marks found. Their measurements agree.
text.the_stones_hum_lower: The stones hum lower here, as through water.
text.e_g_a_d: E, G, A, D, C — with the fallen stone’s lower note beneath them. All six stones sound.
text.the_stones_refuse_the: The stones refuse the box’s song. Something out here sings it differently.
text.the_outcrop_opens_like: The outcrop opens like a held breath.
text.some_corrections_only_ever: The fourth stone answers the higher pitch.
text.the_bird_sings_the: The bird sings the box’s song. Almost.
text.the_bay_gives_up: The bay gives up a road of wet stone.
text.the_lighthouse_remembers_its: The full lighthouse lens seats. Its beam falls through the tower onto the lit model lamp.
text.the_beam_writes_on: The beam returns four figures from the west cliff.
text.the_risen_capitals_catch: Four figures reflect from the capitals above the drowned hall, in the same order as the cliff.
text.far_out_on_the: The beam catches on the drowned hall and holds for one circuit.
text.a_chart_table_and: A chart table. And on it — this island. This lighthouse. This room.
text.centimetre_marks_underfoot_tall: Centimetre marks underfoot, tall as doorways.
text.the_dory_and_its: The beached dory holds one unused oar. Its line remains fast to the jetty.
text.you_set_the_phial: You set the phial from the high pool on the chart table. In the dry air of the study, the little roll of paper loosens from the glass at last.
text.the_inner_door_stands: The inner door stands open. A coat is warm. Damp footprints lead inward.
text.you_have_stood_here: The chair, cup, dust, and clock hand occupy their earlier positions.
text.another_study_west_of: A facing study contains a drained model basin and a lit model lamp.
text.a_bell_buoy_listing: A bell-buoy, listing in the drowned channel. It keeps ringing anyway.
text.you_did_not_run: Under a held gaze, the figure raises its head and breaks into a cold light.
text.far_along_the_shore: A small cold light stands on the far shore for three breaths, then goes dark.
text.you_stop_wading_for: When movement stops, the form surfaces and sends one low note across the water.
text.faint_from_the_kelp: Faint, from the kelp: the note it laid, still crossing the water now and then.
text.click_and_the_sea: Click, and the sea will hurry.
text.down_is_the_only: The plate’s lower ring is lit. Its upper ring is dark.
text.there_is_no_level: There is no level above the surface. Not yet.
text.you_run_the_mechanism: The mechanism reverses. The level marks pass upward one by one.
text.far_down_a_light: Far down, a light is still lit.
text.there_you_are_a: A lit point appears on the model shore.
text.everything_down_here_is: Marks below the water line have sharper edges than those above.
text.the_rope_is_still: The rope is still moving. Nothing down here should still be moving.
text.the_water_over_the: The water over the hall is moving. Something is coming up.
text.the_light_passes_under: The light passes under the water — once, all the way around.
text.the_line_takes_the: The line settles into the cleat’s worn turns.
text.one_true_line_signed: The observed water level is signed beneath the earlier entries.
text.the_small_flame_takes: The small flame takes. The dark backs off by one cot’s width.
text.wound_the_way_he: The spring takes one full turn. The cylinder begins to move.
text.folded_into_my_coat: The folded record fits inside the coat lining.
text.the_drawer_takes_it: The record rests beside the District returns.
text.left_with_him_at: Weighted on the source slab, above the wet line.
text.the_jetty_s_outer: The jetty’s outer arm is a shadow under green water.
text.the_bench_faces_the: The bench faces the sea from inside it now. The seat goes awash with every third wave. The water holds it now.
text.the_skiff_is_off: The skiff is off its blocks and rides at the old anchor, half a gunwale under. The water holds it now.
text.field_report_taken_copied: Note sent — position, view, state and a screenshot went with it.

look.4: “Did you see what the water carried?”
